name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
description: Credit-linked subsidy program to generate employment through establishment of new micro-enterprises. Provides 15% to 35% margin-money capital subsidy on project cost.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Enables collateral-free credit facilities up to ₹5 Crore for new and existing Micro and Small Enterprises through commercial scheduled banks and NBFCs.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: Facilitates composite bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.

name: T-IDEA (Telangana Industrial Development & Entrepreneur Advancement)
department: Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Telangana
description: State-level comprehensive incentive package for new manufacturing MSMEs in Telangana: 15%–35% investment subsidy on plant & machinery, ₹1/unit power subsidy for 5 years, and 100% stamp duty reimbursement.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Government of India
description: Provides collateral-free loans under Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50k to ₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L to ₹10L) for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro businesses in retail, trading, and services.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Provides financial assistance to DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization through approved incubators.
